speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
text: asked the Minister for Communications and Information (a) how many Singaporeans have been trained in cybersecurity to protect our security network; and (b) what is the plan to have adequate Singaporean cybersecurity specialists to meet the challenges.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: It is vital to nurture and grow our cybersecurity workforce to ensure our networks are well protected.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: The Cyber Security Agency of Singapore, or CSA, works closely with our industry partners and other Government agencies in order to do so.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: To meet near-term demand for cybersecurity professionals, we facilitate the training of fresh and mid-career non-cybersecurity professionals for cybersecurity jobs.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: Working with industry partners, we have increased opportunities for Singaporeans to take on cybersecurity roles.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: Companies such as Ensign InfoSecurity, Singtel and DBS offer traineeships under the SGUnited Jobs and Skills package to help fresh graduates gain cybersecurity industry experience.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: The Government will also hire more cybersecurity professionals.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: CSA has also worked with associations, industry and academic partners to introduce programmes under the national SG Cyber Talent initiative to reach out to the young.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: Our Institutes of Higher Learning also offer dedicated courses for students to build up foundational cybersecurity expertise.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: These efforts will nurture and strengthen our cybersecurity workforce to meet Singapore’s needs.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: Indeed, Mr Gan Thiam Poh is correct that we do need to ensure that we have the appropriate security protocols in terms of the hiring practices.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: While the nationality is taken into consideration, the key thing that we have to achieve is the breadth and depth of talent across our cybersecurity landscape in order to benefit both the public sector as well as the private sector here in Singapore.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: Just a brief question with regard to attracting Singaporeans to some of these jobs at CSA and more broadly the wider subset of the IT industry in Singapore.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: We have heard in the debate yesterday about ensuring that Singapore remains cosmopolitan.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: And so, in brief, the question is, has it been difficult for the Government to attract Singaporeans to some of the jobs that are being offered by CSA in the past and what are the prospects going forward?

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: There are two ways to look at this, which is, what are the jobs unfilled and the gaps that are growing or r what is the attractiveness of the job to Singaporeans and local graduates?

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: There are a number of surveys, studies and publications both in the private sector as well as coming out of the public sector that validate this.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: That applies in Singapore, as it does around the globe.
